definitions: Not wet or moist; free from liquid or moisture.
Lacking interest, emotion, or excitement; dull.
Having little or no rainfall; arid.
Of wine or other alcoholic drink: not sweet.
Of humour: subtle and understated, often with a hint of irony.
examples: The clothes were dry after an hour in the sun.
He gave a dry lecture on ancient history.
The dry season lasts for several months.
I prefer a dry white wine.
Her dry wit always made me laugh.
